caption: The drawing depicts a single square object centrally placed on a plain, unadorned background. The square is framed by a raised edge with shading that suggests depth. Inside the square, there is a symmetrical ornamental design consisting of four broad, textured leaves radiating from a central round form. Each leaf curves outward toward the corners, and along the central axis of each leaf is a circular or oval depression, adding further dimensionality. The color scheme consists of various shades of gray and black, giving the drawing a monochromatic appearance. The detailed shading within the leaves and the background highlights the depth and contours of the carved pattern. All elements are precisely rendered within the square, while the surrounding background remains entirely blank. Handwritten annotations are faintly visible in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Architectural Detail
